book.pysift.guide.page1: Welcome to The Sift. The violet pools are Spirit Liquid: touching it drains your health and gives Soul Deprivation. Cure it with a Soul Antidote (crafting table).
book.pysift.guide.page2: Siftite Ore hides underground (y -40 to 40). Smelt Raw Siftite into ingots for Siftite gear: the full set halves the health drained by Spirit Liquid.
book.pysift.guide.page3: Charoite grows in the Violet Slate Abyss and in soul geodes deep below. It is used for compasses, homeward stones, sigils and Soulite.
book.pysift.guide.page4: Three bosses guard their arenas: the Harmonizer (Willow Grove), the Monarch (Amber Dunes) and the Sculk Monstrosity (Violet Slate Abyss). Each drops a core and a shard.
book.pysift.guide.page5: Want a rematch? Craft a Summoning Sigil, place a Sift Altar near an arena and use the sigil on it. The boss returns if it is not already alive.
book.pysift.guide.page6: Cores become weapons: Sonic Staff, Dash Charm and Sculk Hammer. At a smithing table, a boss shard awakens a weapon and makes it stronger.
book.pysift.guide.page7: Inlay a Sift Beacon gem into a chestplate at the smithing table. While worn, players within 8 blocks are immune to Soul Deprivation.
book.pysift.guide.page8: Soulite is stronger than netherite. Forge a Soulite Ingot, then upgrade netherite gear with the Soulite Upgrade template (dropped by bosses and found in ruins).
book.pysift.guide.page9: Each Soulite piece carries a boss ability, and the full set makes you immune to Soul Deprivation. Soulite boots let you walk on Spirit Liquid.
book.pysift.guide.page10: Lost? The Soul Compass points to arenas and ruins (sneak + use to switch). Hold a Homeward Stone for 3 seconds to return to your overworld spawn.

book.pysift.guide.page11: Soul Berries grow beside Spirit Liquid; Gloomcaps glow in caves. Brew them in Awkward Potions for Soul Ward and Echo Sight. Tame a Blub with soul sand or soul soil: it fights and fetches.

book.pysift.guide.page12: The eight jukeboxes at the Ancient City are the key: break one and that portal closes. To open a portal from here, build a closed frame of Soul Crystal blocks and use an Echo Shard on it.
